verdict.rationale: Docs show structured output beyond plain text — paragraph-level blocks with bounding boxes, structural labels, and reading order (block extraction), plus markdown/table formatting and confidence scores — which gives some of the metadata and boundary structure useful for RAG pipelines, and community feedback confirms clean PDF-to-markdown output. However, nothing documents this as purpose-built RAG chunking: there's no mention of semantic chunk sizing, overlap control, embedding-ready segment format, or direct RAG/embedding pipeline integration. missing for 10: explicit chunking strategy/chunk-size controls, embedding-ready segment format, direct RAG pipeline integration guidance, independent evidence of chunk quality for retrieval.
